A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same survey with readable text, Table 1, Figures 1–2, and references. v3 has no appendix; v5 adds an Appendix A containing only template text. No material extraction gaps prevent comparison.

before.justification: v3 synthesizes published research. Table 1 catalogs existing benchmarks, and experimental findings are attributed to cited studies; no original empirical outcomes are reported.

after.justification: v5 remains a literature survey without original experimental, simulation, user-study, or empirical data-analysis results. Its appendix contains no substantive material.

M1.justification: Neither version proposes an original algorithm or model. The reviewed method families remain the same; shortened descriptions do not establish changes to their underlying procedures.

E1.justification: The surveyed task and domain coverage remains unchanged, and Table 1 retains the same 21 benchmark entries. No new training or evaluation coverage is introduced.

E2.justification: Neither version conducts its own proposed-method versus baseline evaluation. The comparator sets in the cited comparisons are retained.

E3.justification: No experimental protocol is introduced or substantively revised. Table 1 retains the same dataset sizes, dialogue lengths, curation categories, evaluator types, and evaluation criteria.

E4.justification: The same published ablations, robustness findings, and case studies are discussed. Rewriting these summaries introduces no additional analysis or test.

E5.justification: No repeated-run information, uncertainty estimates, or statistical testing procedures are introduced or removed. Table 1 retains its human–LLM agreement-check reporting.

E6.justification: The cited numerical outcomes and comparative findings are retained. For example, Section 2.2.2 reports Qilin-Med's BLEU-1 of 16.66 and ROUGE-1 of 27.44 on Huatuo-26M in both versions.

T1.justification: Neither version develops mathematical definitions, theorems, proofs, or derivations. The verbal taxonomies and descriptions of existing methods do not introduce formal theoretical changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the task-oriented taxonomy, application coverage, three families of improvement approaches, and open-challenge synthesis. The central contribution and novelty claims remain equivalent.

C2.justification: Section 3.1.2 strengthens its synthesis of domain-specific multi-turn SFT: v3 says studies suggest it 'can further improve' performance, whereas v5 says it 'consistently yields further gains.' Most Section 4 limitations retain their meaning despite extensive condensation.

D1.justification: Some documentation of surveyed systems becomes less specific. Section 2.2.2 drops SMILE's explicit turn-count filtering criterion and abbreviates HuatuoGPT's evaluator criteria. These are documentation losses, without evidence of changed experiments. The survey's resource link remains unchanged.

R1.justification: v5 adds Latour's 2005 actor-network-theory book as a source in Section 2.2.4. Otherwise, the same works and research positioning are retained; extensive publication-metadata updates and duplicate-reference consolidation do not constitute new coverage.

P1.justification: Substantial rewriting and condensation affect Sections 2–4 and the conclusion. v5 removes the contents pages, reduces detailed subsection numbering and bookmark granularity, changes author presentation, and adds an unfinished appendix template.

P2.justification: The document is extensively reformatted with different typography, headers, and page flow. Table 1 changes from landscape to portrait presentation with narrower wrapped columns and rearranged notes. Figures 1–2 are resized and reflowed while retaining their taxonomies.

improvement.justification: v5 makes lengthy passages more concise and expands reference information, but loses navigation aids and some technical specificity, strengthens the SFT interpretation without new evidence, and leaves template text in Appendix A. The scientific coverage and reported findings remain stable. These competing gains in concision and losses in navigation, precision, and polish leave the overall quality direction unclear.
